I replied to Tobias in your DM to confirm the note: his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Elmstead rollout is now Mondays at 8:45. I made no other changes, including to his calendar.

I also told him I don't have a separate memory store. The note only exists in our DM history, and I'll look there if he asks about it later. I offered to add it to his calendar as a recurring event if he wants. Before I can, he'd need to confirm it's 8:45 AM and say which time zone.
